journeys.title: Welcome and first action
journeys.note: One short explanation and one obvious start action leave room for a real chat example.

journeys.title: Try immersion before signing in
journeys.note: Apple Messages keeps the conversation in view while presenting a translation. Vipi’s interactive preview demonstrates the gesture on a real bubble.

journeys.title: Sign in with Apple, Google or email
journeys.note: Keep provider buttons readable, with email available in the same view.

journeys.title: Sign-in failure and return to an existing account
journeys.note: Preserve the account identifier, put recovery next to the failed field and show which account will reconnect.

journeys.title: Choose a unique username
journeys.note: An unavailable name and an available name need different, actionable feedback beside the field.

journeys.title: Display name and avatar
journeys.note: Show how the contact will look in chat. Name, initials and any available profile image serve different roles.

journeys.title: Find a friend by exact username
journeys.note: The field should say what identifier to enter. Show the matching person and an obvious next action.

journeys.title: Share a personal invite link
journeys.note: Offer a shareable link through the native sheet. Contact access is optional for Vipi’s exact-username flow.

journeys.title: Open a browser invitation
journeys.note: These web invitations identify the destination and next action. Vipi must preserve the exact friend across install or sign-in.

journeys.title: Conversation list and unread counts
journeys.note: Names, previews and timestamps establish a scan order. Put unread emphasis on the conversation row.

journeys.title: Empty inbox and first friend
journeys.note: Give an empty inbox a direct way to find or invite a friend.

journeys.title: Contact avatar and header
journeys.note: Keep the friend’s identity stable and readable next to Back. Vipi reserves one header action for the immersion mode.

journeys.title: Bubble surfaces, dates and time
journeys.note: Compare message shapes, directional contrast, spacing and quiet timestamps across longer and shorter transcripts.

journeys.title: Compose, send and keep the keyboard
journeys.note: The composer stays in reach above the keyboard. Exercise text entry, send and refocus at real phone widths.

journeys.title: Typing indication
journeys.note: Incoming dots sit on the friend’s side. Verify that they clear on arrival, idle expiry and exit.

journeys.title: Queued, accepted, delivered and read
journeys.note: WhatsApp distinguishes delivery from reading using checks. Judge the two states at message size and give them separate accessibility labels.

journeys.title: New arrivals and unread boundary
journeys.note: Preserve the visible message while a person reads history. A divider or a jump affordance explains where new messages arrived.

journeys.title: Jump to the newest reply
journeys.note: Compare navigation back into a live conversation. Vipi’s jump must appear above the composer and preserve position until selected.

journeys.title: Message actions and original wording
journeys.note: Preserve the selected message while the secondary action is shown. Vipi keeps the hold gesture available for revealing originals.

journeys.title: Offline or failed send and retry
journeys.note: Attach the failure and retry action to the message. Preserve the text while retrying.

journeys.title: Contact details and conversation options
journeys.note: Put infrequent options under the person’s details. Keep the routine language switch immediately available.

journeys.title: Choose a practice language
journeys.note: Use familiar language names and a clear selection mark. Keep the active pair visible when the picker closes.

journeys.title: Download, progress and offline availability
journeys.note: Show which language is being downloaded, progress and a way back. Display ready state beside the language.

journeys.title: One-word and full-message switch
journeys.note: Reader mode switches offer an adjacent reference for two states. Vipi needs a single tap that keeps the draft, scroll position and message identities.

journeys.title: One-word exposure across messages
journeys.note: No direct Mobbin match for cumulative vocabulary in a private chat. Use the stable bubble and original/translation relationship as adjacent references.

journeys.title: Whole-message translation and hold to reveal
journeys.note: Source and translated text stay associated with the same utterance. Vipi presents one version in place, with the original available on hold.

journeys.title: Romanization, tone marks and script switching
journeys.note: No reviewed screen shows Vipi’s tone-marked Mandarin chat and double-tap script switch together. Audio/reading views are adjacent references. Vipi’s actual native samples establish rendering.

journeys.title: One-tap audio and word highlighting
journeys.note: Spoken text has a visible position and an accessible stop control. Check spoken-word timing using Vipi’s device voices.

journeys.title: Autoplay and voice preparation
journeys.note: Voice lists and offline voice settings help explain availability. Vipi starts future-message autoplay only after an explicit action.

journeys.title: First-send invitation and system prompt
journeys.note: Keep the invitation optional and near the composer. These references show notification education. Vipi’s first-send timing and keyboard continuity need native verification.

journeys.title: Denied permission and reopening Settings
journeys.note: Offer a direct path to system settings when permissions have already been denied.

journeys.title: Notification settings and privacy
journeys.note: Separate user-visible alerts from private content. Test opening a notification into the exact conversation on each platform.

journeys.title: Settings navigation
journeys.note: One profile header and consistent navigation rows establish scan order. Compare the upper and lower WhatsApp Settings groups with the native Vipi screens.

journeys.title: Light, dark and textured chat surfaces
journeys.note: Compare a conversation preview with theme controls and a real transcript. Keep sufficient contrast for timestamps, text and receipts.

journeys.title: Conversation colors, contrast and message direction
journeys.note: Signal and Messages use saturated outgoing bubbles and quiet incoming bubbles to establish authorship. Discord isolates unread activity on a dark surface. Compare how Strava and SoundCloud reserve orange for actions, then inspect practice-word ink and delivery information inside Vipi’s real bubbles.

journeys.title: Larger text and reading controls
journeys.note: Preview larger text using actual messages. Confirm sender identity, mode action, keyboard and jump remain reachable at large text sizes.

journeys.title: Verify a safety number
journeys.note: Show which friend the code belongs to. Distinguish unverified, confirmed and cleared states.

journeys.title: Changed device or encryption identity
journeys.note: Explain the meaning of changed keys before letting a user proceed. The reviewed security settings and verification views are adjacent to Vipi’s change warning.

journeys.title: Block, unblock and manage blocked contacts
journeys.note: Name the affected person and show the consequence. Keep reporting a separate choice.

journeys.title: Report selected message and review disclosure
journeys.note: Keep a preview of exactly what will be shared and a separate final Submit.

journeys.title: Encrypted history export and recovery password
journeys.note: Show export destination, password setup and the recovery consequence before confirming.

journeys.title: Restore history from a backup
journeys.note: Describe which history is available and what restore will change. Vipi’s file-based restore and lost-password behavior need their own test.

journeys.title: Move to a replacement phone
journeys.note: An explicit start action and an explanation preserve user choice. Vipi’s single-active-device replacement differs from linking several devices.

journeys.title: Delete Vipi data or the broader account
journeys.note: Show scope before the destructive action. The selected profile, consequences and final confirmation must stay visible.

journeys.title: Create a group and select members
journeys.note: Keep the member list, selected people, group name and first conversation together as a complete sequence.

journeys.title: Group transcript and sender identity
journeys.note: Use sender names inside the transcript and a distinct group header. Confirm the treatment remains readable when multiple people reply.

journeys.title: Group details, membership and admin actions
journeys.note: Show who belongs, who can administer the group and the effect of a membership change.

journeys.title: Invite, join and leave a group
journeys.note: Identify the group before joining. An exit confirmation should name the group and make cancellation easy.

journeys.title: Attach and send a photo
journeys.note: Compare entry, picker, selected image, caption, send and return to the thread.

journeys.title: View shared media
journeys.note: Preserve sender context and a direct return to the conversation from full-screen media.
